_note: Kokeba marketing site config. The generator (scripts/site/build-site.mjs) reads every book under content/ and renders one landing page each. Set per-book status + amazon_url here; everything else comes from the book's own data.

brand.name: Kokeba
brand.tagline: A story for every little star
brand.description: Kokeba makes warm, inclusive first books that carry a child's heritage language. Each story pairs an everyday adventure with a few heritage-language words to read aloud together.

newsletter.note: Prefer the hubspot block below. Or set newsletter.action to a Formspree/Mailchimp endpoint. Empty + no HubSpot = button shows a 'connect a provider' note.

analytics.note: Microsoft Clarity project ID. Injected into every page's <head> by the generator. Public value (safe in a static site).

hubspot.note: Create a HubSpot form (Marketing > Forms), then paste its form GUID here. portal_id + form GUID are public values (safe in a static site). When both are set, the site posts signups straight into HubSpot.

ethiopia-0-3-eden-zoo._note: In KDP review (submitted 2026-06-10, live within ~72h). When live: set status to 'available' + amazon_url to https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>, then rebuild + push.
